This cactus is found chiefly in arid climates, especially in deserts, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains fairly easy to find.

A thumb-sized piece of Garíg restores approximately 30 concussion hits. It must be eaten, but the fresh plant smells so revolting that travellers often hesitate to swallow it, even when wounded. This desert cactus is also called Tookash, Garack or Sheloboon.
